content: Imwilahn Aramas Suwed oh Aramas Mwahu 37.0 TITLE NI MAHSEN EN IPRU: En Depit.

content.text: Ke dehr pwunodki aramas suwed akan;
ke dehr pil peirinki paien irail me kin wiahda me sapwung.
Re pahn mwadang sohrala duwehte dihpw me mengila;
re pahn mehla rasehng kisin tuhke me kin mengidi.
Likih KAUN-O, oh wiahda tiahk mwahu,
ke ahpw pahn koukousoan nan sahpwo oh sohte perki mehkot.
Rapahki omw peren rehn KAUN-O;
oh e ahpw pahn ketikihong uhk dahme ke keieu inengieng.
Mweidohng KAUN-O pein kowe;
likih, e ahpw pahn seweseiuk.
E pahn kupwurehda pwe omw wiewia pwung kan en lingalingla duwehte ketipin.
Kanengamahiong oh awiawih dahme KAUN-O pahn ketin wia;
ke dehr pwunodki paiamwahulahn meteikan
de pil irail me kin pweida nan ar koasoandi suwed kan.
Ke dehr pwunod de lingeringer;
pwe met pahn kahrehiong uhk nan apwal.
Irail kan me kin likih KAUN-O pahn sapweniki sahpwo,
a aramas suwed kan pahn koakoahksang.
Ahnsou keren aramas suwed kan pahn sohrala;
ke pahn rapahkin irail, ke ahpw sohte pahn diar irail;
a me aktikitik kan pahn sapwenikihla sahpwo
oh re pahn paiamwahu oh popohl.
Aramas suwed kin wia koasoandi me kin uhwong aramas mwahu
oh re kin kangkakil kin irail ar kailok.
Ahpw KAUN-O kin ketin kiparamatki aramas suwed kan,
pwe e mwahngih me re kereniongehr kamwomwla.
Aramas suwed kan kin ngapkipeseng nair kedlahs oh kosepene nair ketieu,
pwe re en kemehla me semwehmwe oh paisuwed kan,
oh en kemehla irail kan me kin wia me mwahu;
ahpw re pahn mehkihla pein nair kedlahs akan,
oh nair kesik ketieu kan pahn timpeseng.
Mehnda ma en aramas mwahu men eh dipwisou me tikitik,
ahpw e kesempwalasang en aramas suwed koaros ar kepwehpwe,
pwehki KAUN-O pahn ketikihsang kehlail en aramas suwed kan,
e ahpw pahn ketin sinsile me mwahu kan.
KAUN-O kin ketin apwalih irail me kin peikiong,
oh irail pahn sapwenikihla sahpwo kohkohlahte.
Re sohte pahn lokolok ni ahnsou apwal;
pwe ar dipwisou pahn itar ni ahnsoun lehk.
Ahpw aramas suwed akan pahn mehla;
imwintihti en KAUN-O kan pahn sohrala rasehng wahn rohs en nanwel akan;
re pahn sohrala duwehte ediniei.
Aramas suwed akan kin pweipwand, ahpw sohte kin kapwungala,
a aramas mwahu kan me sapan oh kadek.
Me KAUN-O kin ketin kupwuramwahwih, iei irail me pahn koukousoan nan sahpwo,
a irail me rialahr pahn KAUN-O, pahn koakoahksang.
KAUN-O kin ketin kahluwa aramas akan nan ahl me re en weweid ie
oh kin ketin sinsile irail kan me kin kaparanda kupwure.
Ma re pahn pwupwudi, re sohte pahn wonohnte nanpwel,
pwe KAUN-O pahn ketin sewese kapwourirailda.
Ni ei pwulopwul, oh met ni ei mahlahr,
I saikinte kilang aramas mwahu men me KAUN-O ketin likidmeliehla,
de nah seri kan pekipeki ar tungoal kisin mwenge.
Ahnsou koaros e kin kadek oh mweidohng aramas nah mwohni pwe re en doadoahngki,
oh nah seri kan wia kapai ehu ong ih.
Sohpeisang me suwed, oh wia me mwahu,
eri kadaudokomw kan ahpw pahn koukousoan nan sahpwo kohkohlahte;
pwe KAUN-O kin kupwurperenki dahme pwung
oh sohte kin likidmeliehla sapwellime aramas loalopwoat akan.
E kin ketin sinsile irail ahnsou koaros,
a kadaudok en me suwed akan pahn koakoahksang.
Me pwung kan pahn koukousoan nan sahpwo
oh re pahn sapwenikihla kohkohlahte.
Koasoien aramas mwahu me diren loalokong,
oh e kin lamalam pahrek ahnsou koaros.
Kosonned en eh Koht kin poad nan eh mohngiong
oh e sohte mwahn kin mweisang.
Aramas suwed kin mwasamwasahnte aramas mwahu kan
oh kin song en kemeirailla;
a KAUN-O sohte pahn mweidalahng irail pahn manaman en ar imwintihti kan
de ketin mweidohng re en pakadeikada nan mwoalen kopwung.
Koapworopworki KAUN-O oh kapwaiada sapwellime kosonned akan;
e ahpw pahn ketin kawawihiukala ni eh pahn ketikihong uhk sahpwo,
oh ke pahn kilang me suwed akan ar pahn koakoahksang.
I kilangadahr aramas suwed emen me inenen lemei,
me sikdahsang aramas koaros, rasehng sidar en Lepanon pwoat,
a mwuhr, ni ei daulih wasao, e solahr mie;
I ahpw rapahkiseli, oh sohte diar.
Tehk mwahu aramas mwahu, kilang aramas pwung;
aramas meleilei kin mie kadaudoke,
a me dipan akan pahn mwomwla douluhl,
oh kadaudokarail kan pahn kamwommwomwla.
KAUN-O kin ketin doarehla aramas pwung kan
oh kin ketin apwalih irail ni ahnsou apwal.
E kin ketin sewese irail oh kapitirailla;
e kin ketin doare irail sang rehn aramas suwed akan.
pwehki ar kin sohpeiong pwe re en diar sileparail.
